name: playwright-cucumber-framework
description: A beginner-friendly BDD test automation framework built with Playwright, Cucumber (Gherkin) and TypeScript using the Page Object Model.

scripts.report:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['reports', 'test-results'].forEach((dir) => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })); console.log('Cleaned reports/ and test-results/');"
